name: Deathless Initiate
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Deathless Initiate (Combat)
Source Ultimate Combat pg. 95
For you, impending death is a call to wrath.

Prerequisites: Str 13, Con 13, orc or half-orc, Diehard, Endurance, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: You are not staggered while using the Diehard feat, but if you take a move and a standard action or a full-round action while you are at 0 or fewer hit points you take 1 point of damage. Further, while using the Diehard feat, you gain a +2 bonus on melee attacks and damage rolls.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 117
When you are at 0 or fewer hit points, you can spend 2 stamina points to avoid taking damage when you take both a move and a standard action or a full-round action.
